mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary conditions, boosting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If 20-day returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rate signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If returns are positive when UNRATE exceeds 9%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales indicate strong consumer demand, boosting equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If returns don't increase with high RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals supply issues, leading to negative returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If returns are positive when INDPRO is below 93.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment and falling unemployment indicate a strong labor market, boosting returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by 1% and UNRATE decreases by 0.2%
failure_condition: If returns don't rise with these labor trends.

mechanism_narrative: Moderate inflation supports stable economic growth, leading to positive returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If returns are negative in this inflation range.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth and housing starts indicate high demand, boosting returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If returns don't increase with strong GDP and housing.

mechanism_narrative: Rising rates and falling unemployment signal tightening, leading to negative returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by 0.1% and UNRATE decreases by 0.2%
failure_condition: If returns are positive under these conditions.
